name: camchinabridge-open-data
title: Cambridge China Bridge open data: UK-China Import and Export Pulses, China-EU Trade Pulse and China holiday and factory-closure calendar
description: Four small datasets published by Cambridge China Bridge for importers, exporters and researchers: quarterly summaries of UK imports from China and UK exports to China derived from HMRC overseas trade statistics, a quarterly summary of imports from China into each EU member state derived from Eurostat Comext, and China's public holidays, make-up working days and estimated Chinese New Year factory closures taken from State Council notices.

resources.name: uk-china-import-pulse
resources.title: UK-China Import Pulse
resources.description: UK imports from China for the latest calendar quarter HMRC has fully published, compared with the same quarter a year earlier: the headline total, the 12 largest HS2 chapters, the 8 fastest-rising and 8 steepest-falling HS4 headings (headings under GBP 10m in both quarters are left out), and quarterly totals from Q1 2019. Chapter 99 and unclassified lines are excluded from totals. Values are current-price pounds sterling as published by HMRC and may be revised. The file begins with three '#' comment lines carrying the source, citation and OGL attribution; it is byte-identical to https://camchinabridge.co.uk/uk-china-import-pulse.csv.

fields.name: section
fields.description: Which part of the Pulse the row belongs to.

fields.name: code
fields.description: HS2 chapter or HS4 heading code, kept as text so leading zeros survive. Empty for total rows.

fields.name: description
fields.description: HMRC commodity description of the chapter or heading, or 'All UK imports from China'.

fields.name: period
fields.description: Calendar quarter the value covers, written 'Qn YYYY'.

fields.name: value_gbp
fields.description: Value of UK imports from China in the period, pounds sterling (GBP), current prices.

fields.name: previous_period
fields.description: Comparison quarter (same quarter a year earlier). Empty for quarterly total rows.

fields.name: previous_value_gbp
fields.description: Value in the comparison quarter, GBP. Empty for quarterly total rows.

fields.name: change_pct
fields.description: Percentage change from previous_value_gbp to value_gbp (rounded by the source script). Empty for quarterly total rows.

fields.name: gbp_per_kg
fields.description: Value density: value_gbp divided by net mass in kg for the period, GBP per kg. Empty where not computed (totals, or where HMRC gives no mass).

resources.name: uk-china-export-pulse
resources.title: UK-China Export Pulse
resources.description: UK exports to China for the latest calendar quarter HMRC has fully published, compared with the same quarter a year earlier: the headline total excluding precious metals (HS chapter 71, mostly non-monetary gold, reported in its own rows because its swings would otherwise decide the headline), the 12 largest HS2 chapters, the 8 fastest-rising and 8 steepest-falling HS4 headings (under GBP 10m in either quarter left out), and quarterly totals and precious-metal totals from Q1 2019. Chapter 99 is excluded. Values are current-price pounds sterling as published by HMRC and may be revised. The file begins with three '#' comment lines; it is byte-identical to https://camchinabridge.co.uk/uk-china-export-pulse.csv.

resources.name: china-eu-trade-pulse
resources.title: China-EU Trade Pulse (every member state with a page)
resources.description: Imports from China into each EU member state with a page at https://camchinabridge.co.uk/china-eu-trade-pulse/, one block of rows per country (country_code column): the latest calendar quarter Eurostat has fully published against the same quarter a year earlier, the headline total, the 12 largest HS2 chapters, the 8 fastest-rising and 8 steepest-falling HS4 headings (a heading must reach 0.25% of the country's quarter total, between EUR 1m and EUR 10m, in both quarters), and quarterly totals from Q1 2019. Chapters 99 and 00 are excluded. Values are euros as published by Eurostat, monthly data summed to quarters by Cambridge China Bridge, and may be revised. Member states whose series is too sparse are not included. The file begins with four '#' comment lines carrying the source, citation and the Eurostat acknowledgement; it is byte-identical to https://camchinabridge.co.uk/china-eu-trade-pulse.csv.

resources.name: china-holidays-factory-closures
resources.title: China public holidays, make-up working days and factory-closure estimates
resources.description: Mainland China public holiday periods and make-up working days for 2026 from the State Council General Office notice; provisional 2027 statutory days from the national holiday regulations (only dates fixed by the regulations; Qingming, Dragon Boat and Mid-Autumn 2027 are omitted until the 2027 notice is published); and Cambridge China Bridge's own estimates of the Chinese New Year 2027 factory rush and closure. Same dates as https://camchinabridge.co.uk/china-holidays.ics, excluding Canton Fair events.
